mentions.name: Linear Algebra Calculator Page
mentions.description: This web page lets users create matrices, or a matrix and a vector, and performs basic linear algebra operations such as multiplication. It doubles as a refresher tool for linear algebra skills.
mentions.audience: personal-use (explicitly built to help the author refresh their own linear algebra knowledge)
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a little page that will let you create a couple of matrices or a matrix and a vector, and will do the basic algebra for you.

evidence.value: I am working on a little page that will let you create a couple of matrices or a matrix and a vector, and will do the basic algebra for you.
